# Oskvale

> Oskvale designs lithium batteries in Copenhagen and assembles them in Odense, Denmark: e-bike packs, portable power stations and home storage. The shop is https://oskvale.com.

## Battery passports

Every Oskvale battery carries an EU battery passport under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (EU Battery Regulation).

- Issuer declaration (website, ledger account and product collections): https://oskvale.com/.well-known/product-passports.json
- Oskvale Trailcell 500 e-bike battery: passport https://oskvale.com/01/09520606000019/21/000001, independent record https://passportrecord.org/01/09520606000019/21/000001
- Oskvale Basecamp 2500 portable power station: passport https://oskvale.com/01/09520606000026/21/000001, independent record https://passportrecord.org/01/09520606000026/21/000001
- Oskvale Homecell 5 home battery: passport https://oskvale.com/01/09520606000033/21/000001, independent record https://passportrecord.org/01/09520606000033/21/000001
